name: Favro
description: Favro is a collaborative planning platform that combines collections, boards, backlogs and cards for product development and cross-functional work. Teams use shared views and flexible workflows to plan strategy, prioritize delivery and coordinate day-to-day execution.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Favro account email and separate API token. Selected agents can use ten bounded organization, collection, widget and card actions under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions; administration, advanced card data, files, webhooks, bulk operations and raw API access remain unavailable.

credentialRequirements.name: FAVRO_ACCOUNT_EMAIL
credentialRequirements.label: Favro account email
credentialRequirements.helpText: The email address of the dedicated least-authority Favro user that created the API token.

credentialRequirements.name: FAVRO_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Favro API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: A separate revocable Favro API token; choose read-only only when card mutations will remain unselected.

capabilities.label: Read organizations
capabilities.description: List bounded organization identities visible to the connected user.

capabilities.label: Read collections and widgets
capabilities.description: List and inspect bounded collections, boards and backlogs.

capabilities.label: Read cards
capabilities.description: List and inspect metadata-only cards without descriptions or custom fields.

capabilities.label: Manage cards
capabilities.description: Create minimal cards, collision-safely rename them and name-confirm instance deletion.

approvalRequired.label: List organizations
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty organization names and IDs visible to the token user.

approvalRequired.label: List collections
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty bounded active collections in one exact organization.

approvalRequired.label: Read collection
approvalRequired.description: Read bounded metadata for one exact collection in one exact organization.

approvalRequired.label: List widgets
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty bounded active boards or backlogs in one exact collection.

approvalRequired.label: Read widget
approvalRequired.description: Read bounded metadata for one exact board or backlog.

approvalRequired.label: List cards
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty metadata-only cards from one exact collection or widget.

approvalRequired.label: Read card
approvalRequired.description: Read bounded metadata for one exact card without descriptions or custom fields.

approvalRequired.label: Create card
approvalRequired.description: Create one minimal card with a bounded name on one exact widget.

approvalRequired.label: Rename card
approvalRequired.description: Rename one exact card only after its current name matches.

approvalRequired.label: Delete card
approvalRequired.description: Delete one exact card instance only after its current name matches.

blocked.label: Administer organizations
blocked.description: Organization creation, settings, members, roles, groups, domains, SAML, SCIM and billing are unavailable.

blocked.label: Administer collections or widgets
blocked.description: Collection and widget creation, updates, sharing, permissions, columns, lanes, archival and deletion are unavailable.

blocked.label: Change advanced card data
blocked.description: Descriptions, custom fields, assignees, dates, tags, task lists, comments, positions, lanes, columns, copies and dependencies are unavailable.

blocked.label: Manage attachments or webhooks
blocked.description: File upload, attachment mutation and outgoing webhook administration are unavailable.

blocked.label: Run arbitrary Favro calls
blocked.description: Agents cannot choose API origins, paths, routing headers, filters, request bodies or raw REST operations.

blocked.label: Run bulk or everywhere operations
blocked.description: Bulk mutation and deleting every copy of a card are unavailable; deletion is fixed to everywhere=false.

blocked.label: Export Favro data
blocked.description: First-page twenty-row lists, one exact resource and 256 KiB responses are the maximum supported surface.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Private reads and every card mutation require approval. Fixed origin, inherited user authority, exact IDs, bounds, confirmation and audits always apply.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All ten selected Favro actions run without Relay per-action approval; token authority, exact IDs, bounds, field allowlists, confirmation, redaction and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway executes ten fixed Favro REST API v1 actions at the documented origin with exact IDs, first-page bounds, minimal card mutations, confirmation and redaction.
Railway executes ten fixed Favro REST API v1 actions at the documented origin with exact IDs, first-page bounds, minimal card mutations, confirmation and redaction.

providerSetup.blocker: Favro API access requires a user-created API token and the intended organization and collection permissions. A read-only token cannot execute selected card mutations.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the separate provider-console acceptance task, use a synthetic Favro workspace, create a dedicated least-authority user and separate API token, choose read-only or read/write authority to match selected capabilities, enter the email and token in Relay, verify the ten bounded tools, then revoke the token.

evidence.supports: Favro's official API reference documents API-token HTTP Basic authentication, read-only token restriction, fixed API v1 endpoints, organization routing, pagination, rate limits, collections, widgets and card reads and mutations.
Favro describes collections as workspaces for organizing projects and daily work with configurable sharing.
Favro publishes its security and privacy program, including ISO/IEC 27001 and 27701 certification claims.
Favro documents plan differences and API-call availability and limits.
